metrics.report:
Evidence identity/read limits
- Primary incoming evidence: local://mikro-receiving65-parent-upstream-integration.patch, 3,611 lines. Read relevant implementation/test sections 1168–3595, pricing API entirely because new-file patch supplies it, plus incoming bench declarations. Source identities above are patch index abbreviations, not independently hashed files.
- Assigned immutable identities are composed tree e8dd4830ed553a8619234099ef2a7ca5cda41dc1 and current dev fa8469e0e1beb953823bb2619ed0a39fe581dba7. These IDs come from assignment; no object extraction/hash comparison was performed. Do not mistake working source for those objects. Old effective consumers were read at /home/genie/.local/share/mikro-engine-split/experiments-g8/final-local-smokes/history-only-reword-6qjyzwas/tree; those metrics files demonstrably still had old imports/signatures. Broad search also encountered upstream-looking sibling worktrees, which were not used as immutable identity proof.
- Read/search only. No mutations, Git commands, tests, checks, paid requests or report append. Test statements below mean assertions read from source, not observed passing behavior.

API and actual consumers
- New metrics-prices exports: DEFAULT_PRICE_SOURCE, PriceTableMeta {source,fetchedAt,sha256,models}, PriceTable {meta,models:Record<string,unknown>}, PricedTokens {input,cacheRead,cacheWrite,output,cacheWrite1h?}, pricesPath, countPricedModels, loadPriceTable, entryFor, hasTokens, tableCost, PriceUpdateResult, displaySource, updatePriceTable (patch 2637–2841).
- Actual incoming production consumers: metrics-export imports PriceTable/hasTokens/tableCost; metrics CLI imports PriceTable/loadPriceTable/pricesPath/updatePriceTable. Export calls buildIntervals(matched,process.env,prices) and summarize(intervals,prices!==null). Phoenix consumes Interval. Existing task-state capture call passes db.filename; genie-db resolveDbPath promises absolute shared <root>/.genie/genie.db (old source lines 89–91).
- UsageSample adds REQUIRED model:string|null and optional cacheWrite1h:number; actual object construction is confined to Claude/Codex/pi parsers in inspected src/scripts. Existing buildIntervals(matched,env) callers remain valid because new third argument defaults null; summarize(intervals) remains valid because coverage defaults false. LedgerRead now REQUIRES ignored:number, including absent ledger. Optional output fields need no existing-object migration; external typed UsageSample/LedgerRead constructors would need adapters, but no such additional production constructor was found in scoped searches.
- Incoming bench wish declares future read-only loadPriceTable(path)/tableCost/PriceTable consumers (patch line 52 and interfaces near 390), explicitly NOT readUsageSamples or cwd linkage. It is a declaration, not executable accounting integration. Existing scripts/mikro bench/call/phoenix use their own result.costUsd/footer/pricing-basis flow, not this table; README lines 698–715 and call.ts 793–800 explicitly keep historical pricing basis/rows unchanged. No source adapter to those consumers is demonstrated as necessary by these metrics changes.

Optional table and manual fetch contract
- No table or unreadable/malformed wrapper/header → loadPriceTable returns null; no fetch, directory creation or table write during load/export/status. Default path is <GENIE_HOME>/metrics/prices.json. Table presence is the switch; there is no per-export ignore-table option added here. Capture enablement and pricing availability are independent.
- Only explicit prices update fetches default LiteLLM HTTPS source, or --from HTTP(S)/local file; default timeout 60s. Stores one {genie:meta,models} file via same-directory temp+rename, directory 0700/file 0600. SHA covers downloaded bytes, models preserves parsed source entries. URL source stored/displayed without credentials/query/fragment.
- Network/non-2xx/write failure returns code 1; bad JSON/non-object/no model with valid input or output rate/missing local file/foreign URL scheme returns 2. Prior table stays intact on ordinary refusal/failure paths. Source tests cover local/HTTP updates, closed-port/non-2xx failure, previous-byte preservation, metadata, permissions and temp cleanup (patch 2475–2596, 3349–3466).
- loadPriceTable validates wrapper and plain header types/safe nonnegative count, NOT digest verification, freshness, header-count agreement, date syntax or full model entry schema. Thus accepted hand-edited tables can alter later derived exports. This is source-proven validation scope, not evidence of a corrupt real table.

Pricing, incomplete and unknown semantics
- Exact own model key first, then suffix after LAST slash; no fuzzy/date stripping. A present exact key with invalid object does not fall through. Unknown model/nonzero usage → null. Rates must be own, finite nonnegative fields; a used kind lacking rate makes the WHOLE call unpriced, not a partial rate guess.
- Counts negative/nonfinite or cost overflow → null. All-zero tokens → tableCost 0 even without model; export deliberately excludes zero-token TABLE candidates, so a zero-token unpriced record alone stays costUsd:null/pricedCalls:0. Runtime-priced zero-token records ARE still counted: sumUsage's runtime branch has no hasTokens filter. The broad test title 'zero-token call is never evidence' therefore describes table-fill fixtures, not all runtime cases (patch 2139–2168 and 1893–1902).
- cacheWrite is the undivided total. Optional 1h count is capped to total; remainder uses flat/5m creation rate. No TTL split means flat rate; used 1h bucket without 1h rate → null. Prompt=input+cacheRead+cacheWrite; strictly above a threshold picks highest crossed tier. Every used kind must have that tier's rate; no base fallback for missing tier kinds (patch 2715–2757; tests 2425–2472).
- Runtime cost wins, including explicit 0; table only fills costUsd===null calls with tokens. pi parser now turns negative/nonfinite runtime totals into null. Interval cost is sum of KNOWN priced calls, NOT a completeness-guaranteed invoice. Unknown calls remain in calls/tokens; with table loaded, pricedCalls and costSource runtime/table/mixed/null expose partial coverage. Finite sum overflow yields null; interval pricedCalls resets 0 when sum is null. Summary calls covers only known-usage intervals; withUsage separately counts interval linkage coverage. OffloadUsd retains all-or-null accounting and is not table-priced.
- Missing session/log → usage:null; ambiguous linkage → usage:null; window match with zero calls → usage:null. Exact session with readable samples elsewhere can yield calls:0/token zero/cost null inside an empty interval. Missing individual token fields still pass through existing num()→0, so 'unknown never zero' applies to missing usage/linkage/model/rate, NOT presence-preserving per-token accounting. Incoming bench wish expressly recognizes and excludes this parser for that reason.
- Dedup unchanged: Claude keeps last response for message.id across all discovered session/subagent files; Codex suppresses unchanged cumulative totals per rollout file and subtracts cached input from total input; pi emits each assistant usage record with no new dedup. Claude model comes from surviving message.model (<synthetic>→null); Codex latest prior turn_context.model, reset null when a context omits model; pi model as logged. See old usage source 152–234 plus patch 2860–2940.

Historical capture and default-output compatibility: precise exceptions
- CaptureLine schema/version is not changed. No ledger migration or pruning is introduced. Existing task_events join remains (db,task,event,kind,at); rolled-back/missing rows stay unmatched. readCaptureLedger is read-only and historical raw bytes remain preserved (tests patch 1746–1795 and CLI 3467–3497).
- Canonical means lexical absolute path with basename genie.db and parent basename .genie, not filesystem ownership/physical repo validation. /tmp fixture repos are valid. New capture rejects everything else silently; export counts in-window v1 task_event noncanonical/missing-db lines as ignored before joining. Old source accepted these lines and could verify scratch DB copies. Therefore historical STORAGE is preserved but historical EXPORT population is intentionally changed. lines now counts retained canonical lines; ignored appears in CLI JSON/text only when positive. This is a concrete inherited behavioral change, not an optional-price-table migration.
- For canonical ordinary input, no table means UsageTotals/summary/TSV/Phoenix coverage field shapes remain old; CLI tests assert exact old usage object, absent pricedCalls and same TSV (patch 3349–3408). Internal readCaptureLedger object shape always gains ignored. No-table values can nevertheless change from new OMP fallback, invalid runtime-price rejection and finite-sum overflow handling. Universal 'byte-identical without table' would be too broad.
- Table loaded adds usage costSource/pricedCalls; summary calls/pricedCalls/costSource; TSV priced and costSource columns; Phoenix genie.cost_source and genie.cost.priced_calls attributes. Strict positional TSV/closed-schema external consumers would need adapters IF they enable/load a table; no such failing consumer was observed. Table-free caller APIs remain default-compatible.

OMP fallback: actual integration limits
- Exact runtime identity still wins. Idless pi with cwd first uses old equal-header-cwd+startedAt≤event≤file mtime rule. An ambiguous cwd result blocks fallback. ONLY no cwd candidate triggers evidence. Fallback requires canonical db and capture cwd within main/registered worktree checkout, then scans all live top-level OMP sessions (including sessions started in another repo), plus one-level subagent logs.
- Match requires one session with running bash invocation of a recognized card-write verb and no OTHER running session mentioning that task as whole word in decoded tool arguments. Read-only status/eval/xargs/option-value/text mentions do not prove a writer but block another proven session. Results bound execution; missing result allows 60s, ±2s slack. Result label remains window, not exact. Per-export evidence caches parsed files. Source assertions cover these cases, cwd precedence, subagents, other-repo sessions, returned calls, relative/scratch db and outside-checkout refusal (patch 1384–1712).
- Concrete limits acknowledged in source: hidden task variables/scripts do not match OR block; long-running proven calls can claim multiple events. Additional source-visible constraints: recognizer duplicates task verb/option registration and will need synchronized maintenance; streaming prefilter expects compact literal JSON byte markers. Pretty-spaced or fully escaped identifiers can evade evidence collection even though decoded parser could understand them. These are possible-input limitations, not an observed integration failure. Cross-repo same-task-id mentions can conservatively suppress attribution because proof identifies task operand, not command execution cwd. New fallback can change exported historical usage without touching historical records.

Phoenix dedup exception
- Existing stable span ID is hash(salt,db,task,fromEvent,toEvent); price table/version/derived attributes do not participate (old phoenix.ts 136–147). projectToPhoenix posts only IDs absent from storedSpanIds and verifies ID presence, not updated attributes (201–225); incoming phoenix patch only adds attributes.
- Consequently a previously uploaded interval will NOT be repriced/enriched remotely merely by enabling/updating the table and re-exporting, while local JSONL/summary recomputes against current table. This follows directly from unchanged code; no backend run is claimed. It preserves existing dedup/idempotence, but contradicts any expectation that manual prices update backfills already-stored spans. No new remote migration/update mechanism is present or authorized here.

Disposition for parent integration
These are inherited upstream features, not authority to redesign capture/export/wish accounting. Integrate their producer/consumer types together; retain conditional fields and canonical filtering intent. No required stored-record migration or demonstrated adapter to original paid/frozen Mikro report consumers was found. External strict table-enabled schema consumers and remote backfill expectations are unconfirmed dependencies; the source-proven exceptions above should constrain whole-scope review. Original cohorts/data were not read, modified, rerun or appended.

release.report:
Evidence identity / limits
- Incoming evidence: local://mikro-receiving65-parent-upstream-integration.patch, targeted sections 1–30, 639–1167 and 3596–3612. Supporting source reads used /home/genie/.local/share/mikro-engine-split/experiments-g8/final-local-smokes/history-only-reword-6qjyzwas/tree (T below).
- e8dd4830ed553a8619234099ef2a7ca5cda41dc1 and devfa8469e0e1beb953823bb2619ed0a39fe581dba7 are assignment-provided identities, not independently object-bound by this investigation. T visibly still has root version 6.261005.1 and the old preload, so incoming behavior is attributed to patch additions, not asserted present in T. No Git/object commands were run. The empty T/.docs-vendor cannot prove the incoming docs object's existence or contents. No source verdict or frozen-data/cohort changes.

Actual changes / runtime type boundary
- package patch 692–716: root version alone becomes 6.261009.1. Loader test becomes `GENIE_METRICS=off bun test src/`; its `dsh >=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` engine range is unchanged. Its committed version in T is 5.260919.8, which is deliberately advisory, not evidence of an invalid release.
- Doctor patch 1043–1167 introduces `ContextBudgetStatus {value: number|null; source: 'env'|'settings'|'default'|'unknown'; perModelOverrides?: number}` as optional `CheckResult.contextBudget`, serialized under `checks[]`. `checkContextBudget(env = process.env)` produces exactly one pass result; it never writes settings or changes compaction behavior. Existing doctor failure/exit logic considers only status=fail (T/doctor.ts:1853–1868).
- Nonempty CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW wins and is digits-only; invalid input remains null/source=env, with no settings fallback. Empty/unset env reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json, else homedir()/.claude/settings.json. Global settings accepts only integer JSON numbers 100000–1000000; strings including '400000', shorthands, floats and out-of-range values are unknown. Missing file/key is null/default with 400k recommended, not a claimed default of 400000. Malformed/nonobject/array JSON is null/unknown. Per-model numeric valid windows or 'auto' are counted, not resolved for an active model; count is omitted when zero and the env fast-path does not read/count model settings.
- Existing regression intent (patch 903–1042): injected config dir avoids ambient env; precedence, bounds/types, per-model count, missing/default and malformed read-only behavior. Separate doctor --fix subprocess now uses fixture HOME as cwd so mode repair cannot scan registered real worktrees.
- Both skill additions are prose guidance: keep orchestrator near 150–200k, compact/handoff by 400k, delegate broad reads, reports ~2000 tokens with path citations. No budget-schema constant or runtime enforcement changes. CLAUDE's clarification explicitly limits conservative ceilings to budgets.*, not other config sections.

Preload / operator-state contract
- Existing T/scripts/test-preload.ts strips FORCE_COLOR and runtime identity markers and sets GENIE_METRICS=off; bunfig.toml loads it for root tests and excludes mikro/**. Incoming patch 842–872 saves original Bun primitives and wraps array/options-object signatures; absent or undefined env receives a fresh spread of current process.env. Explicit env is passed unchanged. This addresses the documented Bun 1.3 behavior of no-env children inheriting runner-start environment rather than preload mutations.
- Regression patch 717–841 creates a sentinel home with capture.on. Worker uses openDb/createTask/appendTaskEvent against `<fixture>/.genie/genie.db`, deliberately not an arbitrary scratch DB that capture would skip. Bun.spawn array and object, Bun.spawnSync, Node spawn/spawnSync/execFileSync must see `GENIE_METRICS=off CLAUDECODE= FORCE_COLOR=`; sentinel ledger must not exist. Explicit-env positive control must produce one ledger line. These are source assertions, not exercised results.
- Loader script and shell lifecycle export protect paths not guaranteed to load root Bun preload. Explicit-env callers still own their environment isolation; wrapper intentionally does not override explicit capture enablement in fixtures.

Release / lock / staging
- T/package.json: direct @commitlint/lint/load ^21.2.0 already match T/bun.lock workspace entries (lines 19–20) and resolved 21.2.0 packages (79–81); scripts/commitlint.ts imports both. Incoming patch has no bun.lock change. Root lock workspace has no version field: a version-only root bump introduces no visible dependency-resolution change. Do not replace package/lock wholesale with upstream bodies that lose pending direct dependencies. Frozen-install success remains unobserved.
- CI and tarball jobs pin Bun 1.3.11; package floor is >=1.3.10. Linux/macOS CI and release matrix run `bun install --frozen-lockfile`; preserve manifest/lock dependency correspondence before those runs.
- T/scripts/release-payload-version.ts:79–90 `--verify-source` gates root package version shape only, explicitly not plugin committed-version equality. Stamp writes both DSH plugin versions, board minimumGenieVersion and VERSION in copied stage; verify requires exact agreement. Optional retired Orca metadata is checked only if present. T/version.yml bumps root plus surviving Orca metadata, not DSH sources. Thus old source plugin versions are not a hazard to 'repair' by editing them.
- T/build-tarballs.yml:150–176 permits source/request version mismatch only for authenticated stable promotion; dev must equal source package version. T/build-binary.sh compiles source, builds both plugin dist outputs with release version, copies skills/templates, then stamps and verifies stage and extracted archive (169–271), with archive-tree parity and 80 MB size limit. An override does not replace source-version verification or make old artifacts represent new code.
- Incoming release rule records candidate v6.261005.1 trusted-control failure before manifest-only control's push CI completed. It requires next normal dev PR recovery for tagged failures; later green CI/tag/merged repair alone does not prove published delivery. Verify authoritative dev manifest and signed descriptor identify the successful candidate containing intended merges; do not relax control guard or combine signer attempts.

Exact fresh gate/build surfaces for parent
- Rebuild root `dist/genie.js` from src/genie.ts (`bun run build`) after adoption: doctor and incoming noncatalog runtime changes invalidate prior bundle evidence. Root `bun run check` covers typecheck (including both DSH projects), Biome, knip, skills/wishes/complexity and tests. CI additionally runs fresh-install smoke and full-history catalog check; macOS runs build/typecheck/test. Focused existing regression files are scripts/test-preload.test.ts and src/genie-commands/doctor.test.ts; standalone loader package test and V5_E2E_BUILD=1 tests/e2e/v5-lifecycle.sh cover their distinct invocation boundaries.
- Fresh release proof uses scripts/build-binary.sh via build-tarballs.yml on all four platforms, scripts/release-payload-version.ts source/stage/extracted checks, fresh-install-smoke.ts and binary smoke. Relevant existing release regressions include scripts/release-payload-version.test.ts and scripts/release-docs.test.ts. These are existing gate mappings, not a new acceptance matrix; nothing was executed here.

Docs gitlink / specific hazards
- Patch 24–30 requires mode 160000 at .docs-vendor and exact object ea8c0230e6ddcabe302ca6419ab2c99f2d15174c (old 1275fcea5b1eb5eb8b7118170c24ebcb8f825a03). Safe private-index correspondence requirement: the parent's integration index/tree entry must encode that mode/OID from the composed result, rather than deriving it by staging an arbitrary external checkout HEAD or treating the empty directory as deletion. Prove the external commit in the appropriate docs object database without mutating that checkout; a superproject gitlink alone does not supply its commit contents. Availability unconfirmed here.
- docs-lint.yml explicitly triggers on .docs-vendor, uses recursive checkout, and refuses when docs/installation.mdx does not resolve. Docs link/markdown commands are not in root check because local submodule can be absent. Pointer uptake therefore needs independent docs CI; no finding about new docs prose is possible from the empty local vendor directory.
- Source-backed boundary hazards: doctor env early-return hides per-model count; global value is not an active-model resolved value; unknown still passes; explicit-env test children bypass wrapper defaults. Unconfirmed hypotheses, not observed failures: callers expecting an exact doctor checks array or monkey-patching Bun primitives may need adjustment; no such consumer break was demonstrated. No incoming nonmetrics plugin API/engine-floor change or lock dependency bump was found in the patch.
